Scenario / Requirement: Design R1 is based on accepted Stage 7B-c and changes design/docs/checkers only.
Expected Result: Base is exactly c57ae8d5f98bbb11df0a81f78262d3916b276d81; no crates/Cargo/workflow production diff; 7B-d-a remains unopened.

Scenario / Requirement: Stage 6 remains the only lifecycle/execution authority.
Expected Result: Redis markers, ACK maps, DLQ state and settlement capabilities never become Stage 6/request execution identity.

Scenario / Requirement: Terminal ACK settlement authority is represented by a dedicated opaque capability.
Expected Result: Capability is non-Clone, non-Copy, non-Serialize, non-Deserialize, non-publicly-constructible and single-consumption/linear.

Scenario / Requirement: ACK authorization is minted for a finalized Stage 6 request.
Expected Result: It binds exact operational identity, StrategyRequestId, canonical command digest and durable client/request identity.

Scenario / Requirement: ACK authorization is minted only after current seal commit.
Expected Result: It binds Stage 6 checkpoint/frontier fingerprint, recovery-seal generation and committed seal commitment/fingerprint.

Scenario / Requirement: ACK authorization is converted into a transport settlement plan.
Expected Result: Plan is bound to exact canonical ACK fingerprint/classification; a capability for A cannot settle a different ACK payload.

Scenario / Requirement: Transport settlement plan is formed for one Redis source entry.
Expected Result: It binds validated namespace, command stream, consumer group, Redis entry ID and settlement kind without feeding these into Stage 6 identity.
Negative Mutation / Checker: drop entry binding or feed entry ID to Stage6 identity

Scenario / Requirement: Terminal ACK path is inspected.
Expected Result: Only durable Stage6 finalization + committed covering recovery seal may mint DurableAckAuthorized.

Scenario / Requirement: Permanent pre-Stage6 poison is handled.
Expected Result: Uses a distinct PoisonDlqAuthorized capability; it is not the ACK settlement capability.

Scenario / Requirement: Malformed/schema-invalid Redis entry is sent to DLQ.
Expected Result: DLQ authorization requires proof that Stage6 admission did not occur and no Stage6 journal/request mutation exists for the entry.

Scenario / Requirement: Entry reaches IdentityConflict/ReconciliationRequired/RecoveryBlocked/DurabilityUncertain/provider-unknown.
Expected Result: No PoisonDlqAuthorized, ACK settlement or XACK authority may be minted; entry remains held/pending.

Scenario / Requirement: Permanent pre-Stage6 poison has no Stage6 lifecycle mutation.
Expected Result: No Stage6 seal advancement is required solely for poison DLQ; atomic DLQ+XACK remains transport-only.

Scenario / Requirement: A new ACK/DLQ settlement marker key is derived.
Expected Result: Stable key depends on namespace/hash-tag, source stream, consumer group, Redis entry ID and settlement kind; it does NOT depend on ACK/DLQ payload fingerprint.

Scenario / Requirement: Settlement marker value is written.
Expected Result: Value stores schema/version, exact ACK/DLQ fingerprint, output stream and published Redis output ID/classification.

Scenario / Requirement: Same settlement key is retried after response loss with same fingerprint.
Expected Result: Lua returns committed result and does not produce another ACK/DLQ XADD or another semantic effect.

Scenario / Requirement: Same stable settlement key is presented with a different payload fingerprint.
Expected Result: Fail closed before XADD/XACK; conflict is observable and cannot create a second marker/key.
Negative Mutation / Checker: allow second key or overwrite fingerprint

Scenario / Requirement: Terminal request has no known prior canonical ACK publication.
Expected Result: First publication creates a stable request-level canonical ACK marker bound to StrategyRequestId and canonical ACK fingerprint/output ID.

Scenario / Requirement: A new Redis entry carries the exact same request after canonical ACK publication is known.
Expected Result: Stage6 dedupe yields Duplicate/DuplicateCommand ACK for the new entry; canonical request marker remains unchanged.

Scenario / Requirement: A new Redis entry reuses StrategyRequestId with changed immutable identity.
Expected Result: No ACK/DLQ/XACK settlement; pending IdentityConflict; canonical request marker remains unchanged.

Scenario / Requirement: Lua performs a brand-new settlement with no existing entry marker.
Expected Result: Before first write, it verifies the source entry is pending in the expected consumer group; otherwise fail closed without publication.

Scenario / Requirement: Entry marker already proves a previously committed settlement.
Expected Result: Exact retry may return prior committed result even though source entry is no longer pending; it must not re-XADD.

Scenario / Requirement: Redis settlement script handles type/schema/hash-slot/fingerprint/conflict validation.
Expected Result: All expected semantic/type checks happen before the first Redis mutation; no expected error path is reachable after publication but before XACK.

Scenario / Requirement: ACK/DLQ settlement uses Lua/transaction on Redis Cluster-compatible keys.
Expected Result: Source stream, marker(s), output stream and group-related keys required by the atomic script share one intentional hash slot/namespace.

Scenario / Requirement: Seal update outcome is ambiguous after possible rename/fsync boundary.
Expected Result: No settlement capability, readiness false; re-read/reconcile committed on-disk seal or restart owner. No blind generation++ from cached state.

Scenario / Requirement: B-059 response-loss semantics are documented.
Expected Result: Guarantee covers client/process response loss after committed Redis script within one Redis durability/failover domain; Redis persistence rollback is not called exactly-once durability.

Scenario / Requirement: Stage 7B-d-a row allocation is frozen.
Expected Result: d-a may implement B-043..B-051 and B-054..B-056; B-052/B-053 remain pending until real-Redis restart evidence exists.

Scenario / Requirement: Stage 7B-d-b row allocation is frozen.
Expected Result: d-b owns B-057..B-063 atomic ACK/DLQ/XACK settlement; no readiness/PEL-restart overclaim.
Negative Mutation / Checker: move real-Redis restart/readiness rows to d-b without witnesses

Scenario / Requirement: Stage 7B-d-c row allocation is frozen.
Expected Result: d-c owns B-064..B-070 plus final real-Redis restart closure of B-052/B-053.

Scenario / Requirement: Design R1 is reviewed.
Expected Result: No runtime-durable-service/Redis production implementation is added; production code stays byte-equivalent to accepted Stage 7B-c.

Scenario / Requirement: Design R1 review completes.
Expected Result: Only after independent ACCEPT may 7B-d-a implementation start; d-b/d-c and FINAM/live remain closed.
